column1: # term|English example|full Chinese translation
curriculum|A balanced curriculum should give pupils opportunities to apply scientific concepts as well as prepare for examinations.|均衡的课程体系既应让学生有机会应用科学概念，也应帮助他们为考试做准备。
disposable income|After paying direct taxes, the household's disposable income was insufficient to cover rising rent and transport costs.|缴纳直接税后，这个家庭的可支配收入不足以支付不断上涨的房租和交通费用。
succession planning|Succession planning reduces dependence on a single experienced person by preparing other staff to take over key responsibilities.|接班人规划通过培养其他员工接手关键职责，减少对单个资深人员的依赖。
deliberation|Public deliberation allows people to hear competing reasons before deciding how limited local funds should be spent.|公开审议让人们在决定如何使用有限的地方资金之前，听取相互竞争的理由。
advocacy|Community advocacy can bring overlooked needs into a planning discussion, particularly when residents cannot attend formal meetings.|社区倡议行动能够让被忽视的需求进入规划讨论，尤其是在居民无法参加正式会议时。
legitimacy|Transparent procedures can strengthen public legitimacy by showing residents how decisions reflect both evidence and consultation.|透明的程序可以向居民展示决策如何兼顾证据和意见征询，从而增强公众对决策正当性的认可。
consensus|The group reached a consensus on the first stage of the project, although members disagreed about how later work should be funded.|团队就项目的第一阶段达成了共识，尽管成员对后续工作如何筹资存在分歧。
dissent|A useful consultation allows room for dissent rather than recording only the opinions of those who support the proposal.|有效的咨询应为不同意见留出空间，而不只是记录支持提案者的看法。
solidarity|Shared support during a crisis can strengthen social solidarity, especially when assistance reaches people outside existing friendship groups.|危机中的相互支持能够增强社会团结，尤其是在援助覆盖原有朋友圈之外的人时。
reciprocity|A norm of reciprocity encourages people to help one another even when the immediate return for their effort is uncertain.|互惠规范鼓励人们互相帮助，即使付出能否立即得到回报尚不确定。
custodian|A custodian of an archive must preserve its context as well as its objects so that later researchers can interpret the collection.|档案保管者既必须保存实物，也必须保留相关背景信息，以便后来的研究人员解读馆藏。
intangible|Songs and shared practices can be part of intangible heritage that cannot be preserved simply by storing objects in a museum.|歌曲和共同实践可以是非物质文化遗产的一部分，不能仅靠把实物存入博物馆来保护。
authenticity|Restoration can raise questions of authenticity in a historic building, especially when modern materials replace original features.|历史建筑修复可能引发有关原真性的疑问，尤其是在现代材料取代原有构件时。
commercialisation|Cultural commercialisation can bring income and change local practices, so residents should have a voice in how traditions are presented.|文化商业化既能带来收入，也会改变当地实践，因此居民应对传统如何被展示拥有发言权。
confirmation|You will receive written confirmation by email once the deposit has been processed and your room has been allocated.|押金处理完毕并为你分配房间后，你将通过电子邮件收到书面确认。
registration|Complete registration before the first session so that we can arrange access to the laboratory and its equipment.|请在第一次活动前完成注册，以便我们安排你使用实验室及其设备。
cancellation|Please read the cancellation policy before booking, as refunds depend on how much notice you give.|预订前请阅读取消政策，因为能否退款取决于你提前多久通知。
identification|Please bring identification when collecting the key, as staff cannot release it without checking your booking details.|领取钥匙时请携带身份证明，因为工作人员核对预订信息后才能交付钥匙。
encryption|End-to-end encryption protects the contents of messages in transit, although it does not prevent someone from reading an unlocked device.|端到端加密保护传输中的消息内容，但不能阻止他人读取未锁定的设备。
authentication|Two-factor authentication adds a second check to a login, reducing the risk that a stolen password alone will give someone access.|双重身份验证在登录时增加第二道核验，降低了他人仅凭窃取的密码便取得访问权限的风险。
prototype|The team tested a prototype with older users before building the full service, which revealed several problems with the navigation.|团队在开发完整服务前，让老年用户测试了原型，从而发现了几个导航问题。
formative|Formative assessment helps a teacher adjust the next lesson by identifying misunderstandings while there is still time to address them.|形成性评价让教师在仍有时间解决问题时发现误解，从而调整下一堂课的教学。
summative|A final examination is one form of summative assessment, but a completed project can also demonstrate what students have learned.|期末考试是总结性评价的一种形式，而完成的项目也可以展示学生学到了什么。
consolidate|Short review sessions help consolidate learning after a lesson, particularly when students try to recall ideas before checking their notes.|课后的短时复习有助于巩固学习成果，尤其是在学生查看笔记前先尝试回忆观点时。
biodegradable|Biodegradable material still needs appropriate disposal conditions and may persist for a long time if it enters the sea.|可生物降解的材料仍需要适当的处置条件，如果进入海洋，可能会长期存在。
screening|A screening programme needs clear information about benefits and limits so that participants understand what a positive result means.|筛查计划需要清楚说明其益处和局限，让参与者理解阳性结果的含义。
prevalence|Disease prevalence describes how common a condition is in a population and can rise when patients live longer even if fewer new cases occur.|患病率描述一种疾病在人群中有多普遍；即使新病例减少，患者寿命延长也可能使患病率上升。

incidence|Disease incidence concerns new cases during a specified period, allowing researchers to examine whether the risk of developing a condition is changing.|疾病发病情况关注特定时期内的新病例，使研究人员能够考察患病风险是否正在变化。

equitable|Equitable access may require different levels of support because the same application process can impose very different burdens on different households.|公平获得服务可能需要不同程度的支持，因为相同的申请流程可能给不同家庭带来截然不同的负担。
opportunity cost|The opportunity cost of building the stadium is the value of the best alternative use of those funds, such as improving local schools.|修建体育场的机会成本，是这笔资金用于最佳替代用途的价值，例如改善当地学校。
randomised|A randomised trial assigns participants to conditions by chance, whereas a survey may simply observe differences that already exist.|随机分组试验通过随机方式把参与者分配到不同实验条件，而调查可能只是观察已经存在的差异。
